facts.text: All students complete the Compass Curriculum, which requires taking Foundations in the first semester, fulfilling a Major Experience, demonstrating writing proficiency, and reflecting on the Millsaps experience before graduation.

sources.title: Compass Curriculum - Millsaps College
sources.quote: In addition to the Compass Curriculum, you will also take Foundations in your first semester and, before graduation, complete a Major Experience, demonstrate writing proficiency and write a reflection on the value of your Millsaps experience.
